svg.title: P024 · Suppliers outside India or with no email
svg.desc: One row per supplier with a country or email issue. Check the two fields independently. ID 1 is local and contactable, ID 2 fails both checks and ID 3 has a missing country. IDs 2 and 3 survive the OR. One issue is enough for inclusion, and two issues still produce one supplier row. The first matching branch wins. ID 2 receives both labels on one row. ID 3 receives Country missing. FROM Suppliers · one table is enough. The country and email checks apply to one supplier. ID 2 can trigger both checks on its own record and still contribute just one follow-up row.
svg.text: Suppliers outside India or with no email
One row per supplier with a country or email issue.
Supplier 2 has a foreign country and a missing email. How many issue labels should it get?
A triangle marks an example to follow. A dark source band spans its columns. ƒ marks a calculated value. Deeper cell colors mark the values to
follow. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
Which country and email checks fire?

g.aria-label: FROM Suppliers · one table is enough
g.text: FROM Suppliers · one table is enough
The country and email checks apply to one supplier. ID 2 can trigger both checks on its own record and still contribute

svg.text: Check the two fields independently. ID 1 is local and contactable, ID 2 fails both checks and ID 3 has a missing
IDs 2 and 3 survive the OR. One issue is enough for inclusion, and two issues still produce one supplier row.
WHERE Country IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(Country)) != 'india' OR NULLIF(TRIM(Email), '') IS NULL
The first matching branch wins. ID 2 receives both labels on one row. ID 3 receives Country missing.
CASE WHEN … THEN 'Outside India; No email' … END / ORDER BY SupplierID
